categoryDescriptions.utility: For messages about a specific transaction or request the customer initiated. Examples: order confirmations, shipping updates, appointment reminders, account notifications. Free when sent within a customer service window.
categoryDescriptions.marketing: For promotional messages, offers, product announcements, or re-engagement campaigns. Subject to per-user message limits. Use only when the customer has opted in to receive marketing.
categoryDescriptions.authentication: For one-time passwords (OTPs) and verification codes only. Use for login verification, account recovery, or two-factor authentication. Must include the code and its expiration.
